fullText.simplified:
第三十二章、消失的颜色

    为什么兵马俑在土里可以保持鲜艳的颜色，一出土颜色就掉光了呢？
    说到自己的专业知识，石文谦又开始滔滔不绝了起来：“考古界有这样一句话：干千年，湿万年，不干不湿就半年。意思是说，如果墓葬环境非常干燥，物品可能会保存上千年；如果墓葬环境极为潮湿，处于水下，物品也可能保存较长时间，甚至万年。不干燥，也不潮湿，物品不到半年很快就会分解或者坏掉。”
    石文谦转头看向简西，发现她正在若有所思地想着什么。
    石文谦怕她没明白，又兴致勃勃地补充道：“后期研究发现，兵马俑的彩绘颜料中涂了一种叫生漆的物质。这生漆是从树中提取出来的，目的是为了让颜料的颜色更加鲜艳。当兵马俑密封在土里时，非常干燥，自然是没有问题的。一旦出土，湿度发生了剧烈的变化，生漆层迅速收缩，导致颜料与陶俑表面脱落。”石文谦越讲越专业，就好像给考古专业的学生上课一样。
    可能是关于生漆的讲解太专业，简西没听懂的原因，她没有回应石文谦。
    “简西？”石文谦叫道。
    身后还是没有声音。
    “简西？”石文谦立刻回头，发现简西愣在原地。
    “简西？你怎么了？想什么呢？”石文谦立刻回到简西的身边，生怕出现什么意外。
    “你还记得王爷爷说的吗？他讲的关于李主任父亲的事情。”简西抬头问道。
    “记得啊，李主任的父亲参与过兵马俑的发掘工作。他是一个物理专家和环境科学专家，所以关于兵马俑的彩绘脱落问题，他还给出过不同的角度和理论呢。”石文谦边说边想拉着简西继续往前走。
    “他的理论是什么？我记得王爷爷说……”简西的话还没说完，只听到古道前方一声巨响，仿佛是巨石被拉动的声音。
    什么声音？难道是墓室被打开了？有人进入秦始皇的地宫了？来不及细想，石文谦和简西立刻快步往前走，恨不得能跑起来！
    等石文谦和简西跑到了地方，简直不敢相信自己的眼睛。这……这是什么？跟古书中记载的完全不一样啊！这真的是秦始皇陵的地宫吗？如果让石文谦在脑海中设想一百种地宫的可能，都不会是现在眼前的这一种。
fullText.traditional:
第三十二章、消失的顏色

    為什麼兵馬俑在土裡可以保持鮮艷的顏色，一出土顏色就掉光了呢？
    說到自己的專業知識，石文謙又開始滔滔不絕了起來：“考古界有這樣一句話：乾千年，濕萬年，不乾不濕就半年。意思是說，如果墓葬環境非常乾燥，物品可能會保存上千年；如果墓葬環境極為潮濕，處於水下，物品也可能保存較長時間，甚至萬年。不乾燥，也不潮濕，物品不到半年很快就會分解或者壞掉。”
    石文謙轉頭看向簡西，發現她正在若有所思地想著什麼。
    石文謙怕她沒明白，又興致勃勃地補充道：“後期研究發現，兵馬俑的彩繪顏料中塗了一種叫生漆的物質。這生漆是從樹中提取出來的，目的是為了讓顏料的顏色更加鮮艷。當兵馬俑密封在土裡時，非常乾燥，自然是沒有問題的。一旦出土，濕度發生了劇烈的變化，生漆層迅速收縮，導致顏料與陶俑表面脫落。”石文謙越講越專業，就好像給考古專業的學生上課一樣。
    可能是關於生漆的講解太專業，簡西沒聽懂的原因，她沒有回應石文謙。
    “簡西？”石文謙叫道。
    身後還是沒有聲音。
    “簡西？”石文謙立刻回頭，發現簡西愣在原地。
    “簡西？你怎麼了？想什麼呢？”石文謙立刻回到簡西的身邊，生怕出現什麼意外。
    “你還記得王爺爺說的嗎？他講的關於李主任父親的事情。”簡西抬頭問道。
    “記得啊，李主任的父親參與過兵馬俑的發掘工作。他是一個物理專家和環境科學專家，所以關於兵馬俑的彩繪脫落問題，他還給出過不同的角度和理論呢。”石文謙邊說邊想拉著簡西繼續往前走。
    “他的理論是什麼？我記得王爺爺說……”簡西的話還沒說完，只聽到古道前方一聲巨響，彷彿是巨石被拉動的聲音。
    什麼聲音？難道是墓室被打開了？有人進入秦始皇的地宮了？來不及細想，石文謙和簡西立刻快步往前走，恨不得能跑起來！
    等石文謙和簡西跑到了地方，簡直不敢相信自己的眼睛。這……這是什麼？跟古書中記載的完全不一樣啊！這真的是秦始皇陵的地宮嗎？如果讓石文謙在腦海中設想一百種地宮的可能，都不會是現在眼前的這一種。

sentences.simplified: 跟古书中记载的完全不一样啊！
sentences.traditional: 跟古書中記載的完全不一樣啊！
sentences.pinyin: gēn gǔ shū zhōng jì zǎi de wán quán bù yí yàng a
sentences.english: This was completely different from what had been recorded in the ancient books!

sentences.simplified: 这真的是秦始皇陵的地宫吗？
sentences.traditional: 這真的是秦始皇陵的地宮嗎？
sentences.pinyin: zhè zhēn de shì qín shǐ huáng líng de dì gōng ma
sentences.english: Was this really the underground palace of the Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang?

sentences.simplified: 如果让石文谦在脑海中设想一百种地宫的可能，
sentences.traditional: 如果讓石文謙在腦海中設想一百種地宮的可能，
sentences.pinyin: rú guǒ ràng shí wén qiān zài nǎo hǎi zhōng shè xiǎng yì bǎi zhǒng dì gōng de kě néng
sentences.english: If Shi Wenqian were to imagine a hundred possibilities for the underground palace in his mind, ..

sentences.simplified: 都不会是现在眼前的这一种。
sentences.traditional: 都不會是現在眼前的這一種。
sentences.pinyin: dōu bú huì shì xiàn zài yǎn qián de zhè yì zhǒng
sentences.english: .. none of them would be like the one that was before his eyes now.

sentence_translations: Chapter 32: The Disappearing Colors
Why can the Terracotta figures maintain their vibrant colors while buried in the ground, but lose all their color once unearthed?
This was his area of expertise, so Shi Wenqian once again began to speak at length:
“In the field of archaeology, there is a saying:
Dry things last a thousand years, wet things last ten thousand years, half-wet, half-dry things last half a year.
This means that if the mausoleum environment is very dry, items may be preserved for over a thousand years.
If the mausoleum environment is extremely humid and is underwater, ..
.. items may also be preserved for a long time, even for up to ten thousand years.
If it is neither dry nor humid, items will quickly decompose or deteriorate in less than half a year.
Shi Wenqian turned his head to look at Jian Xi and found that she was deep in thought about something.
Worried that she might not understand, Shi Wenqian eagerly added:
“Later research discovered that a substance called raw lacquer was applied to the colored pigments used on the Terracotta warriors.
This raw lacquer is extracted from trees, with the purpose of making the color of the pigment more vibrant.
When the Terracotta warriors are sealed in the ground, it’s very dry, so naturally there are no issues.
Once unearthed, the humidity undergoes drastic changes.
The raw lacquer rapidly contracts, which causes the pigment to detach from the surface of the terracotta figures.“
Shi Wenqian began to speak with more and more specialized knowledge, as if giving a lecture to archaeology students.
Perhaps because the explanation about raw lacquer was too technical for her to understand, Jian Xi did not respond to Shi Wenqian.
“Jian Xi?” Shi Wenqian shouted.
There was still no sound behind him.
“Jian Xi?” Shi Wenqian immediately turned around and found Jian Xi standing there in a daze.
“Jian Xi? What’s wrong? What are you thinking about?”
Shi Wenqian quickly returned to Jian Xi’s side, fearing that something might have gone wrong.
“Do you still remember what Grandpa Wang said? What he said about Director Li’s father,” Jian Xi looked up and asked.
“I remember. Director Li’s father was involved in excavating the Terracotta Army.
He’s an expert in physics and environmental science, ..
.. so he has also provided different perspectives and theories regarding the pigment peeling off the Terracotta figures,” ..
.. Shi Wenqian said as he tried to pull Jian Xi along to continue moving forward.
“What were his theories? I remember Grandpa Wang said …”
Before Jian Xi could finish speaking, a loud noise suddenly erupted from ahead on the ancient path.
It sounded as if a huge boulder was being moved.
What was that sound? Could it be that the burial chamber had been opened? And that someone had entered Qin Shi Huang’s underground palace?
They didn’t have time to think about this carefully.
Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi immediately quickened their pace, almost wishing they could start running!
When Shi Wenqian and Jian Xi arrived at the place, they could hardly believe their eyes.
What … what was this?
This was completely different from what had been recorded in the ancient books!
Was this really the underground palace of the Mausoleum of Qin Shi Huang?
If Shi Wenqian were to imagine a hundred possibilities for the underground palace in his mind, ..
.. none of them would be like the one that was before his eyes now.
